Frozen Explorer:
(Under the influence of the Memory Crystal, the last memories of the Frozen Explorer slowly flow into your mind.)
I never knew that there was such an amazing place near Schuttgart! It's truly incredible! Ice and lava, so close together. I never thought that it was possible.
Even with all the lava, it's freezing here. We are used to cold weather in Schuttgart, but this is something else. The most important thing now is to keep my eyes open. Otherwise... I won't... survive...
(This is the last memory. You can return to Priest of Light Torian.)
